mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Verona Community Park with a temperature of 55 degrees and a beautiful Waxing Gibbous moon in the sky.

The city has two big updates. First, the Department of Public Works is hiring an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects, with a deadline of September 20th. Additionally, the city is offering a rain barrel rebate program to help residents collect rainwater and manage stormwater utilities.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to the Verona Ice Arena for the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, consider checking out yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy incident this past Friday, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for an O W I after officers found her passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The shop is currently closed, but they open their doors at 10 AM. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate P B Crunch.
